summary: Tested 3 new features on top of stable LabStock base: (1) DELETE /api/mapping-tests/{id} + UI Hapus button, (2) GET /api/notifikasi/whatsapp/jadwal + dashboard WhatsApp schedule info, (3) WhatsApp preview '(sudah PRF)' suffix. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed. Frontend: schedule info renders '07:00 WIB' on dashboard, all 247 mapping rows have both Edit and Hapus buttons, full add->search->confirm-delete flow works and toast 'Pemetaan ... dihapus' shows. Regression on mapping add/edit PASS. Backend scheduler task starts without errors.
passed_tests: POST /api/mapping-tests creates mapping and persists to seed_data.json (Mapping_Test)
DELETE /api/mapping-tests/{id} removes from DB and from seed_data.json; second call returns 404
GET /api/notifikasi/whatsapp/preview shows '(sudah PRF)' suffix only for reagen with a PRF in current period; not shown when no PRF
UI: Dashboard shows data-testid=whatsapp-schedule-info with text 'Terjadwal otomatis setiap hari pukul 07:00 WIB'
UI: Pemetaan Test tab shows Hapus (Trash2) button next to Edit on every row (247/247)
UI: Tambah Pemetaan -> row appears -> Hapus with confirm -> row disappears + success toast
Backend scheduler _wa_scheduler_loop starts without errors on startup
critical_code_review_comments: WhatsAppCard fetches jadwal only once on mount (useEffect with [] deps); after actual send the 'sudah_terkirim_hari_ini' flag would remain stale until page refresh. Minor UX polish only.
server.py getting large (~840 lines); consider splitting mapping/monitoring/whatsapp routers into separate modules for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed changes; test used TEST_MAPPING_DEL_XYZ and TEST_UI_DEL_MAP which were both deleted (verified in seed_data.json).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 new features (hapus pemetaan with seed persistence, WhatsApp jadwal 07:00 WIB endpoint + UI info, and '(sudah PRF)' suffix in preview) verified end-to-end. pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py can be reused for regression.
